dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Which is more popular, Phuket or Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɪtʃ ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈpɑːpjələr, puːˈkɛt ɔːr ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Phuket is more popular, I think. It has beautiful beaches.
dialogue.reading: puːˈkɛt ɪz ˈmɔːr ˈpɑːpjələr, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ɪt ˈhæz ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈbiːtʃɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Hotels in Phuket are more expensive, but they're more modern and comfortable.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hoʊˈtɛlz ɪn puːˈkɛt ər ˈmɔːr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, bʌt ðɛr ˈmɔːr ˈmɑːdərn ənd ˈkʌmftərbəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the sea? Is it dangerous?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈsiː? ɪz ɪt ˈdeɪndʒərəs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. In September, it's more dangerous than in December.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ɪn sɛpˈtɛmbər, ɪts ˈmɔːr ˈdeɪndʒərəs ðən ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is the weather better in Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈwɛðər ˈbɛtər ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In December, yes! It's cool and sunny. The weather in Bangkok is worse!
dialogue.reading: ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər, ˈjɛs! ɪts ˈkuːl ənd ˈsʌni. ðə ˈwɛðər ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ˈwɜːrs!
